description: Abstract actor class for handling HTTP requests and responses within the Eclipse Ditto gateway endpoints, managing command processing, timeouts, acknowledgements, and response rendering.

classes.name: AbstractHttpRequestActor
classes.description: An abstract actor class for processing HTTP requests and generating responses, managing command lifecycle, acknowledgements, and error handling within the Ditto gateway.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling behavior, including failure, command, and timeout handling.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Processes incoming Command objects, initiating acknowledgement aggregation and response handling.

methods.name: onAggregatedResponseOrError
methods.description: Handles the result of acknowledgement aggregation, forwarding responses or errors.

methods.name: handleCommandWithAckregator
methods.description: Sends command to target actor with acknowledgement aggregator.

methods.name: handleCommandWithoutAckregator
methods.description: Handles command processing directly without acknowledgement aggregation, deciding immediate acceptance or response.

methods.name: completeAcknowledgements
methods.description: Completes the HTTP response based on acknowledgements received.

methods.name: handleCommandAndAcceptImmediately
methods.description: Handles commands that do not expect a response, replying with HTTP 202 Accepted.

methods.name: getTimeoutExceptionSupplier
methods.description: Provides a supplier for timeout exceptions based on command and context.

methods.name: rememberResponseLocationUri
methods.description: Stores the URI from a command response if the status indicates creation.

methods.name: getExternalHeaders
methods.description: Converts internal headers to external headers for HTTP response.

methods.name: handleWhoami
methods.description: Processes Whoami requests, generating user info responses.

methods.name: createWhoamiResponse
methods.description: Creates a WhoamiResponse based on request headers and authorization context.

methods.name: getAuthContextWithPrefixedSubjectsFromHeaders
methods.description: Extracts authorization context from headers, filtering non-prefixed subjects.

methods.name: handleCommandWithResponse
methods.description: Handles command processing and response awaiting behavior, including timeout management.

methods.name: getResponseAwaitingBehavior
methods.description: Defines behavior for awaiting command responses, handling various message types and errors.

methods.name: handleMessageResponseMessage
methods.description: Converts a MessageCommandResponse into an HTTP response.

methods.name: handleReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout scenarios during response waiting.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts exceptions into HTTP error responses.

methods.name: buildResponseWithoutHeadersFromDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Builds an HTTP response from a DittoRuntimeException, optionally including JSON error details.

methods.name: enhanceResponseWithExternalDittoHeaders
methods.description: Adds external headers to an HTTP response.

methods.name: completeWithResult
methods.description: Completes the future with the final HTTP response and stops the actor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the actor.

methods.name: addEntityAccordingToContentType
methods.description: Adds entity payload to response based on content type, handling binary and JSON.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves content type from headers or defaults to JSON.

methods.name: createCommandResponse
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP response for a command, including headers and optional body.

methods.name: modifyResponse
methods.description: Modifies response to include Location header if resource was created.
